parameters.query: SELECT id, snapshot_version, content, content_hash, policy_count, token_estimate FROM hr.policy_snapshot WHERE is_active = true LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
  c.id AS chunk_id,
  d.external_id AS policy_code,
  d.title,
  c.content,
  c.metadata->>'category' AS category,
  c.metadata->>'source_section' AS source_section,
  c.metadata->>'owner' AS owner,
  c.metadata->>'effective_from' AS effective_from,
  c.metadata->>'effective_to' AS effective_to,
  (c.metadata->>'version')::int AS version,
  ROUND((1 - (c.embedding <=> $1::vector))::numeric, 4) AS cosine_similarity,
  ROUND((c.embedding <=> $1::vector)::numeric, 4) AS cosine_distance
FROM rag.chunk c
JOIN rag.document d ON c.document_id = d.id
WHERE d.is_active = true AND UPPER(d.source_type) = 'HR_POLICY'
ORDER BY c.embedding <=> $1::vector ASC
LIMIT 12;

INSERT INTO audit.chat_request (
  request_id, session_id, question, intent,
  confidence, status, latency_ms, metadata, created_at
) VALUES (
  $1::uuid,
  $2::text,
  $3::text,
  'HR_POLICY',
  $4::numeric,
  $5::text,
  $6::int,
  $7::jsonb,
  now()
)
RETURNING request_id, created_at;
